requirements: Deferred courier fees use an authoritative order transition to delivered after operational start; a lagging waybill does not block the fee.

Any owner-configured prepaid courier is recognized at the authoritative completed order transition after operational start, with one debit to an explicitly approved cashbox. Aramex and international carriers can be manually bound to the Salla cashbox without company-specific code changes.
Prepaid shipping remains fully paid, never an unpaid courier liability or an unallocated advance; later delivery and replay do not debit again.
Preserve frozen existing facts, opening balances, native driver rules, independent COD evidence, and distinct fee/customer currencies.
Do not infer prepaid settlement or cashbox from destination country or sale currency; the owner explicitly selects the company mode and cashbox.

Operational estimated product costs retain repeated line quantities and correctly match Yes/No with Arabic equivalents within a verified option identity; conflicting identities remain visibly incomplete.
completed_in_this_checkpoint: Deferred courier fees use the authenticated order delivered transition; a lagging waybill no longer blocks the fee. Carrier identity, cancellation and replacement safeguards remain.
Historical order creation does not exclude a post-start delivery fee with an independently known contract currency; old sale and supplier records are not recreated.
Native order history and verified status webhooks retain explicit completed evidence and its original timestamp, including later shipping or delivered order states.
Approved prepaid tariffs carry immutable dated owner cashbox bindings; missing, stale, foreign, inactive or unready accounts never authorize a new debit.
A completed prepaid order creates one confirmed shipping charge and one fully allocated cashbox movement atomically; it leaves no unpaid courier liability or advance.
Recorded payments and confirmed shipping charges require matching review before any new automatic debit. Replay, concurrent refresh, later delivery and cancellation preserve the original paid fact.
Paid shipping is included in expense reporting and removed from overlapping open shipping estimates.
Reports and Excel retain separate execution and delivery dates and the cashbox; a replacement carrier has a separate row and cannot inherit the original charge or COD.
Native driver behavior, independent COD proof and original opening balances remain protected by the regression suite.

Concurrent first late-delivery uploads initialize the standard proof storage and non-unique event index after driver authorization, before the owner transaction. One proof and event are retained under replay; financial state remains unchanged.

Shipping settings persist an optional exact original Salla carrier code. Tariff review binds that identity, payment mode, price, effective period and selected cashbox without creating a movement merely by saving settings.

Explicit carrier recognition requires the original code, never a display-name fallback. Duplicate codes, old approved identities and subsequent identity reassignment are rejected; prior catalog party IDs, opening balances and movements remain unchanged.

Operational cost selection retains each raw observation with its IDs and labels, supports Yes/Arabic yes and No/Arabic no within the same trusted option, and does not flatten unrelated options into one match.

Ambiguous or conflicting option observations report incomplete costs and preserve the preceding estimate and confirmed facts. Repeated item lines, quantity multiplication, partial receipts, bundles and confirmed supplier expenses remain protected.
